title: Credit Card Rewards Points Rounding Policy
summary: This document states that all credit card rewards points are rounded down (truncated/floored) to the nearest whole number when calculating points earned. Fractional points are never rounded up; e.g., $126.77 at 1% earns 126 points and $99.99 at 2.5% earns 249 points, across all card types and reward categories.
